title: A local tag whose name starts with a bang, by shorthand escape and by verbatim form
notes: `!%21foo` is the primary handle `!` with the suffix `%21foo`; the escape decodes to `!foo`, and the tag is the handle prefix `!` followed by that suffix: the local tag `!!foo`. `!<!!foo>` is the same tag written verbatim (productions 98 and 99). Both nodes carry `!!foo`, which is not the secondary-handle shorthand `!!foo` (`tag:yaml.org,2002:foo`) and not the local tag `!foo`.

provenance.reference: A reader or writer that read the local tag `!!foo` as the secondary-handle tag, or dropped it, when its name started with a bang.
